description: Search and filter product-relevant evidence from filings, earnings, company pages and web news. Optional company_event metadata denotes a materially current, product-sales-relevant event. Free operation. Excerpts contain direct quotes indicating interest in or need for the product. Each excerpt's text_marked carries <mark>…</mark> tags identifying the most relevant product or event sentence(s) — quote or emphasize those sentences when presenting evidence, converting the tags to bold/emphasis if the rendering surface cannot display HTML. text_marked is HTML-escaped outside the tags; use the plain text field with the highlights offsets when raw text is needed. NOTE: the keyword filter matches against each excerpt's tagged pain points (see the product's keywords from get_product), NOT the raw quote text — a keyword absent from the pain-point tags returns zero results even if it appears verbatim in a quote.

include_highlights.description: Include per-excerpt sentence highlights (highlights spans + text_marked with <mark> tags). Defaults to true.

keyword.description: Filter by match against the excerpt's tagged pain points (product keyword vocabulary), not the raw quote text

name: search_excerpts
